description: Read the hash-chained evidence ledger that every grade is derived from: one record by id, every record linked to a lane, or the whole chain when no argument is given. Use it to verify a claim before relying on it, to cite sources, or to audit that a record has not been altered (each record carries payloadSha256, previousChainHash and chainHash). Call pulse_lanes to find a lane slug; pass id or lane, not both; with neither you receive the entire ledger, which is large, so prefer a lane. Read-only and idempotent. Works without an API key on the free tier. Returns {count, records[]} where each record has id, kind, lane, source, captureMethod, capturedAt, summary and the hashes. An unknown id or lane is refused with an error naming it.

id.description: Evidence record id to fetch on its own, as found in a lane's evidence[] or a previous call. Takes precedence over lane.

lane.description: Lane slug (from pulse_lanes): returns every evidence record linked to that lane.

name: pulse_evidence

records.description: Evidence records with id, kind, lane, source, captureMethod, capturedAt, summary, payloadSha256, previousChainHash and chainHash.

title: Read the evidence ledger
